# Final Authorized Plan

The Awtsmoos creates the movie data and renderer as distinct vessels in each instant's light;
Awtsmoos.com shall never collapse intelligence into rendering—agents declare, engines execute right.

## Execute

1. Trace every prompt/provider/director import and test call site.
2. Identify the smallest canonical data state API already available.
3. Implement machine-only agent bridge and data import UI in focused modules.
4. Rewire Director Dock into Data Studio tabs without prompt semantics.
5. Rewire shared runtime and all app installers to remove provider injection.
6. Convert revision UI/state to explicit patch JSON/data only.
7. Remove language interpretation exports and unreachable modules from the public runtime surface.
8. Replace prompt-centric tests with data-contract, opaque-text, direct-agent-load, patch, and browser tests.
9. Verify all adapters, showcase, mobile UI, export, and 180-second artifact remain correct.
10. Reread touched files, compare planned vs actual, and close remaining work only with evidence.

## Authorized behavior

The UI may present text editors containing JSON and literal movie text content. It may not inspect literal text to decide scene structure, feature selection, camera kind, timing, transitions, or renderer semantics.
